job.job_description:
Data Platform Engineer (Snowflake)




Experience: 3 to 8 years in Snowflake Data Warehouse
Education: 15 years of full-time education




Role Summary:-

We are looking for a Data Platform Engineer with strong Snowflake expertise to design, build, and optimize enterprise data platforms. The role involves collaborating with Data Architects and Integration Architects to ensure seamless data integration, scalable data solutions, and efficient data workflows.




Key Responsibilities:-

Design and support data platform architecture and components.
Develop, maintain, and optimize Snowflake-based data warehouse solutions.
Collaborate with Data Architects and Integration Architects on data models and system integration.
Build and manage ETL/data integration processes.
Monitor and improve data pipeline performance and reliability.
Support project delivery and contribute to technical decision-making.



Required Skills:-

Strong experience with Snowflake Data Warehouse.
Good understanding of data warehousing concepts and best practices.
Experience with ETL processes and data integration.
Proficiency in SQL and database management.
Ability to analyze and optimize data workflows.



Preferred Skills:-

Exposure to AI/GenAI-enabled data solutions is an advantage.
